stock_control_desc: Track every unit that enters or leaves your store. Monitor stock levels, manage suppliers, and keep costs under control.
purchase_orders_desc: Buy from your external suppliers and record the goods that arrive.
physical_inventory_desc: Perform actual stock counts and reconcile discrepancies between the system and physical goods.
stock_card_desc: What each branch has, what it is worth and what is below minimum. Write off and correct balances.
stock_desc: Balance, average cost and value of each product in the branch. Every change is recorded in Movements.
no_branches: Create a branch to start managing inventory.
inbox_load_error: Could not load the pending items for this branch.
no_stock: This branch has no inventory products yet.
void_desc: Opposite movements are recorded and the balance goes back to how it was. The document stays in history as voided.
writeoff_exceeds: You cannot write off more than what is on hand.
correction_desc: Enter what you counted. The system records the difference as surplus or shortage.
levels_desc: The alert shows when the balance drops below the minimum. The maximum is used to suggest order quantities.
levels_invalid: The maximum must be greater than or equal to the minimum.
transfers_desc: Request from another branch, dispatch what you're asked for, send and receive goods.
lines_search: Search product by name or code…
lines_empty: Pick products from the list or search them by name.
share_desc: Send it via WhatsApp, copy it or print it.
share_phone_hint: Type a phone number to open WhatsApp.
orders_page_desc: What this branch buys from the suppliers in the Suppliers section. Requests to another branch are in Transfers between branches.
order_who: Which branch are you requesting from?
order_no_suggestion: No products below the maximum to order.
order_no_last: There is no previous order to this supplier yet.
order_cancel_desc: The order is cancelled and can no longer be dispatched.
order_close_desc: What is missing will no longer be sent. What was dispatched or received is kept.
receipt_new_desc: Goods that arrived at {{branch}} without a prior order.
receipt_void_desc: What receipt {{number}} added is subtracted from inventory.
transfers_page_desc: Everything between your branches: requests, shipments and what arrives. At the top you see what this branch has to handle.
transfer_stock_hint: It comes out of this branch's stock. You cannot send more than there is.
transfer_check_hint: Type what actually arrived. If something is missing, choose the reason.
difference_returned: The difference went back to inventory
difference_lost: The difference was recorded as a loss
production_desc: Produce semi-finished goods from their recipe and know their real cost.
production_page_desc: Record what this branch produces: each recipe's ingredients go out and the products come in at their real cost. One order can hold several products.
production_no_module: {{branch}} does not have the Production module. Assign it in the branch settings.
production_new_desc: Record what was already produced at {{branch}}: ingredients go out and products come in at once.
production_plan_desc: Build the order with everything to produce (one or several products) and check the ingredients. Stock doesn't move until you record it.
production_no_products: No products to produce: they must track inventory and have a recipe.
production_produced_hint: If less came out due to waste, type the real amount: the cost is spread over what came out.
production_fix_hint: First fix the ingredient's inventory, then produce again.
production_cancel_desc: No inventory was moved; it just stops being pending.
production_void_desc: The ingredients of {{number}} go back to stock and the products go out. Only possible if they're still at the branch.
margins_hint: Margin = price without taxes − cost. Cost is the average of what you have; for dishes, what their recipe costs.
margins_empty: No products are sold at this branch.
sales_desc: Sell to businesses or customers from the back office and see each sale's profit.
sales_page_desc: Sales from this branch to a customer or business (e.g. the CP sells bread to another restaurant). It comes out of inventory and keeps the profit.
sale_stock_hint: It comes out of this branch's inventory and cannot leave negative balances. The suggested price is the branch sale price.
sale_void_desc: What left with sale {{number}} goes back to inventory.
lines_no_stock: This branch has no stock of any product to send.
lines_all_added: You already added every product in the list. Search by name to see others.
margins_supplier_hint: Other branches buy at its sale price; when dispatching you can add a % or set a special price. Products without a sale price start from cost.
price_no_sale_price: No price or cost: choose a special price
price_bulk_label: Add the same % to all (over their sale price or cost)
margins_where_to_edit: Sale price and whether it is sold here are changed in Items → branch products → Edit → Prices.
price_base_is_cost: No sale price: the % is added to the cost.
po_who: Which supplier are you buying from?
po_no_suppliers: No suppliers yet. Create them in People → Suppliers.
transfer_only_to_supplier: Without a request you can only send to a supplier branch. To send to another branch, dispatch its request in "Requested from me".
transfers_action_request_desc: Ask another branch for what you need.
transfers_action_send_desc: Send to a supplier branch without a request. Other branches get goods when you dispatch their request.
transfers_action_send_desc_supplier: Send to any branch without a request.
transfers_requested_hint: Requests this branch made to others. When they dispatch, the shipment shows in Shipments for you to receive.
transfers_requests_hint: Requests other branches made to this one. Open them to dispatch.
production_fix_hint_many: Ingredients add up across all products in the order. Fix the stock or remove a product.
production_variant_desc: Add or remove ingredients. Accepting creates a new product with this recipe; {{name}} stays the same.
production_variant_batch: Quantities for one batch that yields {{quantity}}.
production_variant_name_hint: It will be an exact copy of {{name}} (branches, prices, taxes, packagings and modifiers) with this recipe. It has no barcode and no stock.
production_variant_unchanged: Add or remove an ingredient (or change a quantity) to create the new product.
production_variant_confirm_desc: Accepting this recipe creates {{name}}, an exact copy of {{original}} with these ingredients, and produces it instead. {{original}} and its recipe don't change.
